Welcome Home

Our mission is to provide everyone with the beautiful home that they deserve. Whether you are a first-time buyer, relocating, downsizing, decorating, or redecorating your home, Fairway Home can provide you with all the furniture you need. Ultimately, your home should be personal and reflect your unique style. We aim to provide the right furniture and household goods for everyone, regardless of their taste.

Our Story, So Far...

Fairway is a friendly street in The North West, Droylsden, Manchester. During the 2000s, young families from around the country began to move in. The street became very lively and each individual home had its own character. Whether it is the living room or the front garden, families spent time decorating the area with unique decorations and furniture. This made Fairway a truly homely place.

Fairway Home was created to celebrate the spirit of these families and their homes. We aim to provide the best in class, locally-sourced furniture and household goods to help people nationwide build their dream homes.

Why Buy from Us?

Fairway Home specialises in domestic furniture and household goods. We only purchase from local furniture wholesalers, not only because of the quality, but also because the products are more suitable for UK homes. Together with our in-house dedicated customer service team, Fairway Home is looking to provide you with an alternative way to purchase furniture.

Free Delivery on all Orders- We offer free delivery for all orders in the United Kingdom.

Local Furniture and Goods- All our products are purchased from local furniture wholesalers to ensure quality and suitability.

Supporting Local Businesses- By purchasing from us, you are supporting the domestic furniture supply chain and creating new jobs for future generations.

40 Days Return Policy- Hassle-free returns. With a 10-day trial period and a 30-day return period, you can try out our furniture stress-free.

Fairway Home Latest Reviews

"Lucky to discover Fairway Home! My dining chairs are ideal for everyday meals and occassional get-togeother. Feeling delighted! :)" From Jenny, United Kingdom
